text:
Alice: Morning — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8432 is ready; it's blocking the RC cutover at 10:00. Need a double OK before 9:50 so we can merge and kick canary. Small change to kv cache warmup, CI is green. @Ben @Priya can one of you take the second signoff?

Ben: looking now, should be a quick pass, give me 10.

Priya: pinged — I'm in the middle of standup but will do a quick review after. if it's trivial I can approve.

Ben: quick nit in unit test assertion, leaving comment. overall looks safe.

Sam: did a quick staging smoke run on canary-1 after Ben's branch build — no obvious regressions. :thumbsup:

CI-bot: All checks passed for PR 8432 (linux, mac, integration).

deploy-bot: Canary smoke OK, but perf note: p95 latency +3% on kv fetch in canary-1 (monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood/in/xyz)

Ben: noted. that's within our 5% soft threshold for now. resolving my comment and approving. :white_check_mark:

Priya: approved as well — left one tiny formatting nit (non-blocking). :white_check_mark:

Alice: thanks — merging now and starting canary rollout. merge command:
```
gh pr merge 8432 --squash --admin
```
Autobackout policy set at t+20m if errors > 5%.

QA-bot: queued post-merge regression job: test_kv_warmup.sh — will post results to this thread.

Sam: I'll watch infra metrics for the next 30m. ping me if CPU or mem spikes.

Alice: copy — will update here with canary metrics. if anyone sees anything, message in #eng-oncall and tag @Sam.
